description: This file defines the PimReportMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and is responsible for configuring reports menu items related to the PIM module in the Human Resource Management system. The class uses traits for module screen helpers and overrides a screen with a specific identifier.

classes.name: PimReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements the MenuConfigurator interface to customize menu configuration for the PIM reports in OrangeHRM. Uses traits to facilitate screen manipulation and overrides a screen to set up predefined reports.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides a screen related to predefined reports by calling getCurrentModuleAndScreen and then overrideScreen on the returned object. Returns null as it does not create a new menu item.
